name: National Textile & Apparel Inc
old_description: Founded in 1994 and headquartered in Hazlehurst, Mississippi, National Textile is North America's largest manufacturer of protective clothing for Nuclear power, weapons, environment restoration and industrial applications.
about:
National Textile & Apparel Inc was founded in 1994 in Hazlehurst, Mississippi, where it operates from a facility on Industrial Drive. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The company manufactures a broad range of protective and specialty apparel, including work and safety coveralls, jackets, bibs, parkas, inmate and correctional clothing, underwear, laundry bags, shoe covers, hoods, medical scrubs, chef wear, and flame‑resistant garments compliant with NFPA 70E. It also produces insulated hunting coveralls, battle dress uniforms, and clean‑room apparel. Processes include custom textile manufacturing, gas transfer printing, and sublimation transfer printing for logos and custom designs. The firm describes itself as a custom manufacturer with wide knowledge of textile and apparel production.

Customers span nuclear power, weapons programs, environmental restoration, industrial facilities, energy departments, clean‑room operations, correctional institutions, culinary businesses, medical facilities, military units, and outdoor recreation. The company has shipped orders to New Zealand, Australia, and Canada, and has produced custom‑printed chef coats for a West Coast cafe and a Canadian client.

National Textile states its vision is to be the best supplier of high‑quality, defect‑free protective clothing in North America, backed by a workforce proud of its accomplishments. Its mission emphasizes delivering the best value with fast response times and on‑time delivery. The executive officer has committed the organization to the highest level of quality to conform to customer requirements.
